verdict.rationale: telli documents "Charlie," a built-in AI assistant that can build/refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze calls, and this assistant is also exposed via an MCP server for external AI tools to interact with. This directly matches delegating tasks to a built-in assistant within the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Charlie's task delegation in practice and more detail on the scope of tasks it can autonomously execute.
